attribution.name: 未署名
attribution.note: The inscription names no writer or calligrapher.
attribution.noteZh: 碑文未署撰文者与书丹者姓名。

attribution.name: 孙兴
attribution.note: The inscription says the donors “hired the craftsman Sun Xing to cut the stone”.
attribution.noteZh: 碑文作「賃師孫興，刊石立表」，即刻工孙兴。

attribution.name: 韦萌等
attribution.note: Former subordinates who erected the stone; the reverse lists forty-one donors.
attribution.noteZh: 故吏韦萌等立石，碑阴列捐资题名四十一人。

background: An Eastern Han stele of 186 for the magistrate Zhang Qian. A secondary album note places the stone in the Dai Temple stele corridor at Tai’an.
